title: Chapter 1440
text:
Han Xiao shook his head and retracted the vision of (Information Form Obliteration).

The abilities he had drawn this time were not bad. The Tree God was ranked third on the Good Person List in his heart, and the second was the Germinal Organization leader.

The first place belonged to Manison, who was unshakable and forever a god.

"Speaking of which, there are still many good things on the Tree God. If only I could draw a few more times … However, the World Tree probably won't use this move on me so easily again. I feel like the chances aren't high."

Han Xiao stroked his chin and pondered.

This time, he had also seen a part of the Tree God's background from the options. Among them, (Tree King Crown-Liberation) confirmed his guess. The Tree God was indeed the product of the fusion of the various Tree Kings. It seemed to have a huge consumption. Now that he had beaten the Tree God away, the possibility of the other party using this move against him was not high.

"However, based on the current situation, the three Universal Civilizations have already taken the initiative. They're the ones sitting on pins and needles now."

Han Xiaoxin smiled.

The current situation was very good, much more comfortable than in his previous life. Most of it came from his efforts. The entire galactic society is under my control!

At this moment, black flames appeared in front of him and quickly condensed into Oathkeeper's mental projection.

"Your Excellency Black Star, the three Universal Civilizations are cleaning up the battlefield. Our Holy Covenant organization has already taken the opportunity to retreat and has not had much interaction. What instructions do you have for the next step?"

Han Xiao glanced at him and saw how submissive Oathkeeper was. He could not help but laugh. "Your attitude changed very quickly. Are you afraid after seeing my heroic appearance?"

"…" Oathkeeper's eyes twitched, but he did not say anything.

It was impossible to admit it, not in this lifetime.

Seeing that he did not answer, Han Xiao clicked his tongue and said, "Don't be so reserved. I still like your unruly look."

"… Stop joking."

"Alright, alright, I won't tease you anymore." Han Xiao smiled, then his expression turned serious. He pondered and said, "The Holy Covenant has been exposed to the world this time, but I don't plan to let you guys debut … ahem, I mean, come out. In short, continue to return to the shadows. Without my call, you don't need to take the initiative to participate in the battle, and don't interact too much with the three Universal Civilizations. It's best if all contact is conveyed through me. "

"How are we going to explain this to the Association? They will definitely ask when this batch of revivors appeared. If you keep hiding it, it might make them suspicious … "Oathkeeper said.

"You don't have to worry about that. I'll explain it to you while keeping the details of the Holy Covenant a secret."

Han Xiao waved his hand.

"Alright." Oathkeeper nodded.

"By the way, there's one more thing. The members of the Holy Covenant don't have to do anything, but you have to contribute your secondary dimension technology, such as the Dimensional Exile Bullet, Energy Disruption Wave, and so on, to be used in battle."

"Alright, I'll listen to you."

Oathkeeper had already been worn down by Han Xiao, so he agreed expressionlessly.

…

At the same time, the Supercluster Alliance was holding a meeting. The leaders of the various civilizations had complicated expressions. Some were happy, and some were worried.

"The three Universal Civilizations repelled the World Tree's secondary dimension invasion … How ferocious."

"At this rate, the three Universal Civilizations will be able to firmly stop the enemy outside the explored universe. The situation won't be chaotic."

"If that's the case, we won't be able to carry out the plan …"

The leaders of the civilizations did not know what to say.

The original plan of the Super Star Cluster Alliance was that while the three Universal Civilizations were busy fighting the World Tree Civilization, they would take advantage of the fact that the three Universal Civilizations were too busy to take the entire civilization out of the explored universe and escape from the three Universal Civilizations' territory.

However, from the looks of it, the three Universal Civilizations were not in a tough battle at all. They were clearly very stable!

It was all Black Star's fault. He was too ferocious and did not give them a chance to carry out their plan!

"Sigh, the plan to leave the explored universe is one of the few chances for us to obtain free space to develop. Let's continue to wait and see. I hope the World Tree is more reliable."

The Star Arc leader sighed helplessly.

This plan was very important to the Supercluster Alliance. Even if the current situation was not good, they would not give up easily. However, it was inevitable that they would feel depressed.

This time, a civilization leader narrowed his eyes and said in a low voice, "Maybe we can help the World Tree …"

However, before he could finish, the Star Arc leader glared at him and scolded, "Don't drag us down if you want to die! If we're found out, we're dead meat! "

He could not believe that someone would make such a suicidal suggestion. Was he tired of living?

No matter how much they hoped that the World Tree would disrupt the battle, they could only silently cheer for the World Tree and wait for the situation to change. How could they give any substantial help? Wouldn't that be colluding with the enemy?!

Speaking of this, the Star Arc leader was furious. Your World Tree is so awesome. I thought you could beat the crap out of the three Universal Civilizations, but you can't even get past Black Star.

Invading like this?

What a joke!

…

A few days later, the great victory in the shallow dimension quickly spread throughout the galactic society under the promotion of the three Universal Civilizations. Although they had agreed to Han Xiao's request and did not emphasize the battle between him and the Tree God, it still caused widespread excitement among the galactic residents.

Initially, when they saw the World Tree invading from the secondary dimension at the beginning of the news, most of the galactic residents were terrified and panicked. Only when they saw the three Universal Civilizations successfully repel the enemy did they heave a sigh of relief and become excited. They were even more confident that the three Universal Civilizations would win this war.

Because they felt that staying in the explored universe was much safer, the chaos on the various refugee planets was greatly reduced. Many galactic residents settled down, and the frequency of demonstrations decreased. There were also fewer people who sneaked away, making it easier to manage.

This time, the Holy Covenant Revivors who suddenly appeared became an important contributor to the war. However, they left after the battle and did not communicate with the three Universal Civilizations. Their actions were very mysterious, arousing the curiosity of the galactic residents.

On the internet, many galactic residents recognized the identities of some of them based on the Wayne Cards. They were all famous Beyond Grade As in history.

Therefore, all the clues pointed to Black Star, who controlled the Sanctum Revival. Countless galactic residents enthusiastically let their imaginations run wild, and various versions of guesses spread on the internet. Chasing the text

In the conference hall of the Beyond Grade A Association's main planet.

All the Beyond Grade As gathered in the hall and stared at Han Xiao, who was sitting on the main seat, talking at once.

"Black Star, you have to give us an explanation, right? Who are those revivors?"

"That's right! You've been hiding it from us all this time. "

"This must be related to you. If you say you don't know, I'll ignore you for a month!"

Most of the people who asked were the Beyond Grade As of the current era, while Beiger and the other Revivors did not speak and just watched from the side.

"Ahem, that …" Kasuyi raised his hand slightly and coughed. "Actually, I know a little about this too."

As soon as he said that, everyone's eyes sharpened and gathered on him.

No way, when Black Star first revealed his cards about the Sanctum Revival, you already knew in advance. How did you know now and even helped Black Star hide it from us?

In the past, when we saw your thick eyebrows and big eyes, we felt that you were experienced, so we chose you as the vice president. Now, it seems like you've completely turned into Black Star's appearance!

Sierron was envious. We're all vice presidents, so why do you know so many secrets while I'm kept in the dark like a fool? You guys are just treating me as a decoration!

Damn it, I can also be a trusted aide. I also want to wear the same pants as Black Star!

Han Xiao was a little surprised. He turned to look at Kasuyi. "When did you find out?"

"I guessed."

Kasuyi smiled embarrassedly.

During the training, Han Xiao had entered the Sanctum once and asked Oathkeeper to contact Kasuyi.

Although Oathkeeper did not reveal the situation of the Holy Covenant, Kasuyi had a preconceived notion that Oathkeeper was Han Xiao's secret subordinate outside. After some deduction, he guessed that Han Xiao might have a backup plan and might have hidden a group of revivors. Therefore, Kasuyi was not surprised that the Holy Covenant organization had appeared. Instead, he had a feeling of 'as expected'.

Han Xiao thought for a moment and guessed where Kasuyi had found out. He did not mind and turned to look at everyone with a smile.

"I originally planned to explain this to everyone. Back then, when the three Universal Civilizations clashed with the association, I deliberately hid a group of revivors and formed a special group. If anything happened to us, we still had a way out and a way to counter the enemy, so don't blame me for hiding it.

You all know what happened after that. The World Tree suddenly invaded, and we made peace with the three Universal Civilizations and fought against the enemy together. Therefore, this trump card was kept. Not long ago, when the secondary dimension battlefront was in danger, I asked them to come out and provide support. "

Everyone nodded. They all accepted this explanation and had no objections.

However, Sun Hunter asked casually, "Since they've been exposed, why didn't they join the association?"

Han Xiao smiled. "This involves our future development path. In my imagination, a portion of the Beyond Grade As should form an organization in the dark, one in the light and one in the dark with the association. Unless something big happens, they will stay in the dark. These mysterious revivors are the first batch of members that I have my eyes on. They are not all following orders, and they also have thoughts of retiring, so this mission is very suitable for them.

I plan to keep this system as a place for the Beyond Grade As to retire. When everything stabilizes, if anyone is tired of disputes and politics, they can choose to retire from this organization and regain their identity. "

As soon as he said that, everyone's eyes flashed. They caught Han Xiao's unspoken words and could not help but look at him deeply.

It seemed like Black Star was no longer satisfied with the association's form after advancing to the Transcendent Grade. When the war ended, he would most likely use the official position recognized by the three Universal Civilizations to do something big …

"War is indeed a catalyst for ambition …"

Many Beyond Grade As sighed.

However, from a personal point of view, they did not reject this point. Black Star was ambitious, which was a good thing for their group.

"Then I have no objections."

"Us too."

"You're the one with foresight."

Everyone expressed their agreement one after another, and began to flatter him with familiarity.

Han Xiao smiled. Just as he was about to speak, the interface suddenly vibrated.

He was slightly stunned and quietly opened the interface. When he saw the notification, his eyes lit up.

Version 5.5 Activated!

Retrieving data … Retrieving data complete!

Player forum opened.

Welcome to Galaxy Version 5.5 — [Black Star's Era — War of All Realms]

"Oh, this small update is finally over?"

Han Xiao was instantly energized.

The players had gone offline more than ten years ago and updated a small version. He did not expect the cute leeks to return at this time.

However, Han Xiao was not happy for long. His attention was attracted by the change in the name of the version.

"War of All Realms?"

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes.

According to his experience, the node of the version update was usually on the eve of some major event.

Now that the three Universal Civilizations were in a good situation, the World Tree was in a passive position, but the version had such a name. This made him feel that things were not simple.

"Whose War of All Realms is this version referring to? Are we going to overturn the World Tree, or is the World Tree attacking the three Universal Civilizations like in my previous life? Now that they're stopped outside the border of the Flickering World, do they still have such a chance … Hmm, it's best to investigate before it rains. "

Han Xiaoxin pondered, his eyes flickering.
